cases.title: Resolve carbonate and bicarbonate with two alkalinity endpoints

original_checks.criterion: Save first-stage and additional second-stage doses separately; cumulative T includes both.

original_limitations: The formula is an ideal two-component alkalinity approximation; gas exchange, finite endpoints and activity corrections shift the result.

cases.title: Indicator selection matters for a weak-acid titration

original_checks.criterion: Relate each colour to the simultaneous pH rather than to the same fractional dose.
Indicator inventories remain trace compared with the acid/base pool.

original_limitations: Indicator colour is a bounded teaching model; no exact visual detection threshold or human colour judgement is implied.

cases.title: The same bicarbonate sample moves in opposite directions under acid and base

original_checks.criterion: Compare carbon species distributions as well as pH.
The acid arm has a different gas-phase carbon allocation while both closed total carbon budgets remain 1 mmol.

original_limitations: Initial headspace air contributes to total pressure; compare CO2 inventories rather than assigning all pressure change to reaction.

cases.title: Boiling and carbonate treatment do not remove the same hardness

original_checks.criterion: Calcium in the heated arm is not falsely removed as CaCO3 without a carbon source.
The treated filtrate is depleted in calcium relative to its feed.

original_limitations: Boiling causes water loss, so compare calcium moles and phase inventory rather than concentration alone.

cases.title: Iron oxidation state determines whether iodide is oxidised

original_checks.criterion: Link iodine production to Fe(III) reduction rather than merely to iron colour.
Check dissolved oxygen or other oxidants before interpreting the ferrous arm.

original_limitations: Counterions differ between FeCl3 and FeSO4; the intended contrast is redox state, with full speciation retained.

cases.title: A late stopper cannot recover gas that already escaped

original_checks.criterion: Account explicitly for carbon transferred out before the first vessel was sealed.
Sealing must not restore previously lost carbon.

original_limitations: The initial atmosphere added when sealing belongs to the baseline and must be distinguished from introduced CO2.

cases.title: Equal carbon amounts need different acid doses before fizzing

original_checks.criterion: Compare initial CO2 allocation rather than total pressure alone.
Final retained carbon across phases remains 1 mmol per closed vessel.

original_limitations: Different sodium/chloride pools and temperatures can keep final pressures from being exactly equal.

cases.title: Separate a dissolved nonpolar solute from a soluble salt

original_checks.criterion: Confirm that naphthalene was dissolved before filtration.
Track sodium/chloride and naphthalene separately through extraction.

original_limitations: Extraction depends on the model’s partition data; a solid naphthalene residue changes the intended comparison.

cases.title: Cooling before filtration changes what can be recovered

original_checks.criterion: Identify dissolved and solid KNO3 at both filtration steps.
Calculate crystal recovery from phase inventories, not from total vessel mass alone.

original_limitations: Use measured temperatures; dissolution heat can cause premature crystals before the first filtration.

cases.title: Distillation rejects a nonvolatile salt but may carry a volatile acid

original_checks.criterion: Identify acid in v4 rather than inferring it solely from low pH.
Compare nonvolatile sodium/chloride carryover with the volatile acid budget.

original_limitations: Acetic-acid/water volatility and activity data may be approximate; the experiment does not promise a quantitative separation factor.

cases.title: Recover three physical fractions from an immiscible liquid–solid mixture

original_checks.criterion: Identify the composition of each destination rather than assigning it from vessel number.
Close water, hexane, salt and silica balances across all three vessels.

original_limitations: Interfacial trapping, emulsions and solid entrainment may be outside the ideal model.

cases.title: A magnet distinguishes metallic iron from dissolved iron ions

original_checks.criterion: Compare metallic and dissolved iron transfer independently.
A magnetic susceptibility concept must not be confused with bulk extraction of all iron ions.

original_limitations: Real dissolved ions can be paramagnetic; the claim is about ordinary bulk magnetic separation, not zero magnetic susceptibility.

cases.title: Serial dilution: absorbance follows concentration, not total copper

original_checks.criterion: Use reported actual volumes and species concentrations, not an assumed volume convention for dilute.
Compare the same spectral feature and check for complexation or precipitation before fitting a linear dilution relation.

original_limitations: Absorbance calibration, wavelengths and copper optical coverage depend on the instrument model; sulfate complexation can change with dilution.

cases.title: Filtration can remove scattering without removing dissolved colour

original_checks.criterion: Resolve silica retention and copper transfer separately in the material balance.
Distinguish a missing scattering model from an actual absence of solid particles in the starting sample.

original_limitations: Adsorption onto silica and wavelength-dependent scattering may not be implemented.
Do not assume the uvvis instrument treats turbidity as absorbance.

cases.title: A weaker iodine colour can mean dilution or reduction

original_checks.criterion: Compare oxidised-iodine equivalents across I2 and I3- rather than interpreting either individual species alone.

original_limitations: I2/I3- speciation itself shifts on dilution.

cases.title: Distinguish hydroxide contamination from bicarbonate in an alkaline sample

original_checks.criterion: The first endpoint accounts for more than half of total alkalinity.

original_limitations: Do not apply the hydroxide/carbonate formulas to arbitrary buffers or to a sample already altered by atmospheric carbonation.

cases.title: Bracket an iodine endpoint with known thiosulfate increments

original_limitations: Triiodide/iodine optical response and thiosulfate ownership need inspection; spectra are teaching outputs, not calibrated laboratory absorbance.

cases.title: Sweeping ammonia changes the composition of a basic buffer
